title: Two Different Jobs
setting: A pretty little cafe with small tables and a big window.

characters.name: Kofi
characters.look: Kofi, a young man with short black hair and a blue shirt

characters.name: Hana
characters.look: Hana, a young woman with long brown hair and a green sweater

sentences.en: Kofi and Hana have lunch in a pretty cafe.
sentences.zh: 科菲和哈娜在一家漂亮的咖啡馆吃午饭。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a young man with short black hair and a blue shirt and Hana, a young woman with long brown hair and a green sweater sit at a small table in a pretty cafe with flowers in the window.

sentences.en: A waiter brings them two cups of tea.
sentences.zh: 一位男服务员给他们端来两杯茶。
sentences.scene_prompt: A young waiter in a black apron puts two cups of tea in front of Kofi, a young man with short black hair and a blue shirt and Hana, a young woman with long brown hair and a green sweater.

sentences.en: Kofi works in an office for a big company.
sentences.zh: 科菲在一家大公司的办公室上班。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a young man with short black hair and a blue shirt sits at a desk with a computer in a busy office of a big company.

sentences.en: His job is boring, with too many meetings.
sentences.zh: 他的工作很无聊，会议太多。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a young man with short black hair and a blue shirt yawns at a long meeting table with people in suits.

sentences.en: Hana is a farmer, and she loves her farm.
sentences.zh: 哈娜是一位农场主，她很爱她的农场。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana, a young woman with long brown hair and a green sweater stands smiling in a green field with cows and a red barn.

sentences.en: She has a business selling eggs and milk.
sentences.zh: 她做生意，卖鸡蛋和牛奶。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana, a young woman with long brown hair and a green sweater sells eggs and bottles of milk at a little farm stall.

sentences.en: Her small team of workers helps her every day.
sentences.zh: 她的小团队里的工人们每天都帮她干活。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana, a young woman with long brown hair and a green sweater and a few farm workers carry baskets of eggs together.

sentences.en: The young waitress wants to visit Hana's farm.
sentences.zh: 年轻的女服务员很想去哈娜的农场看看。
sentences.scene_prompt: A young waitress in the cafe listens excitedly to Hana, a young woman with long brown hair and a green sweater, who shows her a photo of cows.
